map.优惠券折扣计算器核算叠加多张优惠券后的实际折扣力度、最终成交价与节省金额，支持满: The coupon discount calculator works out the effective discount strength, final transaction price and savings after stacking several coupons, supporting threshold discounts, percentage discounts and no-threshold vouchers, for promotion planning.
map.满减券叠加店铺折扣，算最终到手价与折扣力度。: Stack a threshold coupon on top of the store discount to get the final price paid and the discount strength.
map.核对「满多少可用」门槛是否达标。: Check whether the "spend X to use" threshold is met.
map.算实际折扣率和相当于几折。: Compute the effective discount rate and the equivalent discount level.
map.：原价合计 299、店铺折扣系数 1（不折）、满 200 可用 30 元券 →: : original total 299, store discount factor 1 (no discount), 30 CNY coupon usable at 200 -> final 269 CNY, saving 30 CNY, effective discount = 30/299, about 10.0%, equivalent to 269/299 x 10, about 9.0 of the original price.
map.：原价 150、满 200 才可用的 30 券 → 不触发，最终仍为 150；提: : original price 150 with a 30 coupon usable only at 200 -> not triggered, so the final price stays 150; the user is told to add 50 more for the coupon to be worthwhile.
map.实际折扣率怎么算？: How is the effective discount rate computed?
map.实际折扣率=节省金额/原价×100%，并可用 最终价/原价×10 换算成「几折」: Effective discount rate = amount saved / original price x 100%, and final price / original price x 10 converts it into a "discount level", which is more intuitive than the face value.
map.券后价能低于 0 吗？: Can the price after coupons go below 0?
map.工具已做保护，券后价最低为 0，不会出负数，运营配券时注意避免资不抵债。: The tool is protected: the price after coupons floors at 0 and never goes negative, but watch out when configuring coupons so you do not sell below cost.
